all_trials.note: Pairs whose observed dwell_ms is 0 are left out of the dwell figures and counted in n_zero_excluded; in the matching a row of dwell_ms 0 is a zero-length interval that never enters a pair, so it counts as a false positive (as pre-registered), and it is counted in zero_dwell_rows. Intervals are cluster-bootstrap (blocks) for dwell_ms and Wilson for proportions; read them as the width visible from this sample. The oracle report is built from every trial of the oracle and for every session definition, not only the definition matched here.

primary.note: the primary estimates are the comparison and scope named here, per stratum; every other comparison and scope is secondary. A cell without a prediction (the prediction models the macOS observer only) has the comparison gt_obs and the scope all_trials only. Values under all_trials depend on this design's fraction of long trials (see predictions)
primary.note_windows: for a cell on Windows this replaces the sentence of note on a cell without a prediction: such a cell has the comparison gt_obs only, and its scopes take the long trials from the oracle (the presses sent in the trial span at least limit_ms; deviation D3), so its primary estimates are gt_obs under under_limit with the definition windows_def. Detection under under_limit with the long trials of the ground truth (under_limit_gt_duration) is a sensitivity analysis; see long_trials_from of the cell
